_comment: Manually maintained trust/capability overrides. Keyed by 'providerId/modelId'. Merged over catalog.generated.json at runtime. Overrides win. Provider-level overrides use key 'provider:<providerId>'.
_format: Model entries can override: trust, capabilities, jurisdictionTags, deprecated, notes, displayName. Provider entries can override: baseUrl, apiStyle, tier, name, docsUrl. New models (not in generated catalog) are added.

poolside/default.notes: Tested end-to-end in Q2AV as primary inference provider.

sarvam/sarvam-105b.notes: Sarvam's flagship chat model. Tools, always-on reasoning, 128K context. ₹29.28/1M input tokens.

sarvam/sarvam-105b-conversations.notes: Dialogue-tuned variant of 105B. Not a capability upgrade — separate use case.

sarvam/parse.notes: Document intelligence: OCR, tables, layout-aware. 23 Indian languages. ₹0.5/page. India-jurisdiction secondary default.

sarvam/vision.notes: General image understanding (captions, OCR, tables). Pricing not published.

sarvam/gemma4.notes: Open-weights Gemma 4 pass-through on Sarvam endpoint. Images + tools. ₹36.6/1M input tokens.

sarvam/glm5.2.notes: Open-weights GLM 5.2 pass-through on Sarvam endpoint. Tools, switchable reasoning. ₹128.1/1M input tokens.

sarvam/saaras:v4.notes: Speech-to-text. Not eligible for inference slots.

sarvam/saaras:v3.notes: Speech-to-text. Not eligible for inference slots.

sarvam/bulbul:v3.notes: Text-to-speech. Not eligible for inference slots.

sarvam/mayura:v1.notes: Translation. Not eligible for inference slots.
